# SSD 固件与硬件设计知识库

这是一个中文 SSD controller/firmware/hardware 设计知识库，聚焦 NVMe SSD 内部实现：FTL、NAND、ECC/LDPC、掉电恢复、性能/QoS、验证和量产要求。

## Start Here

- README: README.md
- Wiki index: wiki/index.md
- Knowledge map: KNOWLEDGE_MAP.md
- Provider setup: LLMWIKI.md and tests/README.md
- Sources: SOURCES.md
- Glossary: GLOSSARY.md
- Traceability matrix: TRACEABILITY_MATRIX.md
- Test plan: TEST_PLAN.md

## Quick Routes

- Learn the controller model: wiki/concepts/ssd-system-architecture.md
- Trace a host command: wiki/concepts/nvme-command-lifecycle-in-ssd.md
- Design firmware state and recovery: wiki/concepts/firmware-ftl.md and wiki/concepts/ftl-metadata-format-and-recovery-conventions.md
- Review hardware boundaries and RTL interfaces: wiki/concepts/controller-hardware-module-boundaries.md and wiki/concepts/controller-rtl-ip-reference.md
- Plan validation and evidence: wiki/concepts/ssd-verification-matrix.md and wiki/concepts/verification-evidence-and-fault-bridge.md
- Check implementation references: sources/implementation-smoke-test-matrix.yml and sources/open-source-implementation-pins.yml
